title: Wind forcing, mean closure and jet response

criteria.q_reference: RMS x-varying transverse-mean q at window start; imposed horizontal-mean q0 excluded
criteria.mean_current_normalization: maximum RMS parent mean-current increment over window, fixed throughout window
criteria.error_statistic: maximum RMS forecast error over sampled window
criteria.scope: Operational criteria, not universal physical thresholds. No jets at weak feedback is not theory failure. Propagation and scale-transfer claims remain separate unless directly measured.
